dek: Crowds packed the World Robot Conference while humanoid athletes sprinted 100 metres in 9.32 seconds. Unitree, AgiBot and Honor showcased faster, cheaper hardware, as ball-screw and reducer prices fell sharply and robot entertainment deals emerged.
